scope: Type 4 purchase codes; legacy types 1-3 unchanged
Cycle renewal extends max(now, expiry); traffic renewal adds quota and retains usage
Issue-time immutable plan/period/quota snapshot; one redemption per code
Atomic code claim, entitlement, zero-panel-receipt order, entitlement event and usage
Admin issue/export/status; user before/after preview and order history; modern and legacy APIs
Schema 68 upgrade preserving existing parent/child records; deployment backup/recovery

rules.cycle: Existing same-plan cycle subscriptions retain quota and usage, extend by configured calendar months using existing Asia/Shanghai order calendar. Missing reset schedule initialized; existing schedule retained. Ongoing traffic reset scheduling remains governed by plan/system administrator settings.
rules.traffic: No expiry; existing same-plan unlimited-time subscription adds frozen bytes; never resets used traffic.
rules.mismatch: Reject other plan or cycle/traffic mode switch without consuming code, including expired different-plan subscriptions.
rules.pending: Require user to cancel pending order or await processing completion; never auto-pay/cancel original order.
rules.snapshot: Frozen at generation: plan id/name, period, quota, initial group/speed/device/reset settings. Later template edits affect only future codes; template type immutable after issuance. Renewals preserve existing subscription limits and periodic quota.
rules.orders: source gift_card_purchase; amount zero means no panel receipt, not free; external amount unverified; no commission/refund automation. Mixed-source entitlements cannot be automatically converted into panel upgrade credit.
rules.retry: Same owner receives same usage/order; other users rejected; unique code/order association.

non_goals: No changes to legacy gift rewards or normal onetime renewal semantics
No external payment verification/webhooks, automatic refunds, inventory sales status or automatic delivery
No production rollout or real-code consumption during engineering checks
